task: Classify microsatellite instability status in colon adenocarcinoma. Classes: negative vs. positive. On H&E, MSI-high positive tumors are suggested by dense tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, mucinous or medullary features, poor gland formation, and pushing borders, whereas negative tumors more often show conventional adenocarcinoma morphology.

classes.0: Microsatellite stable or MSI-negative tumor with conventional gland-forming adenocarcinoma morphology and fewer tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes.
classes.1: MSI-high positive tumor with prominent lymphocytic infiltration, mucinous or medullary features, poor differentiation, and pushing growth.
